title: Video Project Motion Director Output
description: Matches the MotionDirectorSkillOutput type in server/services/videoProjectMotionDirector.ts — the motion-director adapter parses the skill output against this shape. Template SELECTION + parameter BINDING only: NO property name in this file may match /prompt|imagePrompt|videoPrompt|negativePrompt/i.

sceneId.description: An existing scene id from the input's scenes list.

items.description: The adapter canonicalizes missing or malformed optional-shaped fields and then validates templateParams against the real template registry. Keep emitting the complete shape whenever possible.

templateId.description: Must key into the input's availableTemplates list exactly.

templateParams.description: Must satisfy the chosen template's own paramsJsonSchema exactly. Bind real data only — never invent a value.

label.description: Short human-facing name distinguishing this candidate from the scene's others.

rationale.description: What makes this candidate different from the scene's OTHER candidates. Free-form prose is allowed here only.

summary.description: Short free-form summary of the proposed variants.
